caption: Retrolens archival aerial view of Bay View, Hawke's Bay, 1948-07-06. This image documents the earlier film-survey source material used in geospatial mapping and digital imagery archives.

derivativesNote: The verified Commons upload is preserved unchanged, with separate uncropped WebP derivatives. The upload may differ from the original Crown negative.
